## Pre-registered backtest grid

Under the [shared rules of round 1](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/821). Pooled across the six leagues.
- **Sharp input:** the Betfair Exchange `1x2` and O/U 2.5, with both snapshots from the same source run. Pinnacle is not used: it needs a new input and live quota.
- **Model:** Dixon-Coles scoring rates fitted to the devigged exchange `1x2` and O/U 2.5 with a fixed ρ. The rule is `totals_implied` with `outcome: draw`. [Totals-implied favourite](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/839) is a version in the same family.
- ρ ∈ {0, −0.1} × threshold ∈ {0.01, 0.02, 0.03}: 6 cells.
- Decision times [60, 30]; `max_input_age_minutes`: 10.
- **Data risk:** this needs `betfair_ex_uk` on totals 2.5 in the backfill ([#707](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/707)). Without it, there is no development input before live OddsPortal data.
